text: Aaron Gordon was given a double technical in the fourth quarter against Golden State on Oct. 26 and exited the court. He had seven points. He played 25 minutes.
Aaron Gordon had 15 points, 11 rebounds, three assists and two threes on Oct. 28.
He had 15 points, four rebounds and five assists in 29 minutes Friday against Phoenix.
He returned to the starting lineup on Sunday, with Jarace Walker moving to the bench.
Aaron Nesmith is in the starting lineup while Tyrese Haliburton is out, but he has struggled without Haliburton.

Aaron Nesmith played a season-high 27 minutes Wednesday and scored 18 points with three three-pointers and two steals while shooting poorly on high volume. He has been on a minutes cap coming off a hamstring injury, and his minutes are trending up.
Nesmith's usage ramped up in Indiana's last game with Tyrese Haliburton, T.J. McConnell and Ben Sheppard out.
He started but played only 21 minutes in Friday's lopsided loss at Miami, down from 27 in the previous game, and scored nine points.
Aaron Wiggins played 29 minutes off the bench on Saturday and had 16 points, 5 rebounds, a steal and a block.
Wiggins has played 22 and 29 minutes off the bench in his last two games and has become a key part of the rotation.

Aaron Wiggins has been the player Atlanta turns to when it rests Nickeil Alexander-Walker and CJ McCollum, who have stayed around 30 minutes. If Wiggins is out, McCollum, Alexander-Walker and Dyson Daniels would likely play more.
Aaron Wiggins continues to hold a strong bench role for Atlanta. He had 10 points in 24 minutes on Oct. 28.
Aaron Wiggins scored 20 points with 7 rebounds and four 3-pointers in 24 minutes off the bench on Oct. 29. He is expected to play in the low 20s in minutes.
Aaron Wiggins has scored in double figures in all six of Atlanta's games this season while coming off the bench. He has done it with hot 3-point shooting and very few free-throw attempts.
He played 34 minutes Monday with 17 points, 10 rebounds and three blocks. He has started Utah's last three games and should see more minutes and usage with Jaren Jackson Jr. out.

Ace Bailey gets a big boost with Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic out and Lauri Markkanen and Jaxson Hayes questionable. He played 34 minutes on Oct. 26 and started and played 40 minutes on Oct. 28.
Ace Bailey played 40 minutes Wednesday with Utah missing several starters and scored 19 points with six rebounds.

Ace Bailey should see extra usage with Jaren Jackson Jr. out and Lauri Markkanen and Jaxson Hayes banged up. Keyonte George and Darryn Peterson are the only other Utah players looking for shots if Markkanen sits.
Ace Bailey is averaging about 8.5 rebounds and nearly two blocks per game this season on 53% shooting from the field. He has not recorded a steal yet.
Mara played 14 minutes on Sunday and could see more time if Jaylin Williams is out.
He had 11 points, 10 rebounds and two blocks in 20 minutes off the bench Monday with Chet Holmgren out.

Aday Mara has been one of the main bench players with Chet Holmgren out, and he played 21 minutes on Oct. 28. If Holmgren, Isaiah Hartenstein and Jaylin Williams are all available, Mara would likely drop to about 10 minutes.

He averaged about 20.5 minutes, 8.5 points, 6.5 rebounds and two blocks over Oklahoma City's last two games with Chet Holmgren out. He is a candidate for more minutes during Holmgren's eight-to-10-week absence.
Adem Bona played 14 minutes on Thursday on about 9% usage.
He played 25 minutes with Joel Embiid out on Sunday and had 6 points, 13 rebounds and 3 blocks. He is the backup center who plays when Embiid rests.
Adem Bona played just four minutes on Oct. 28 with Joel Embiid back.
Adem Bona played 25 minutes on Oct. 25 the last time Philadelphia started Dean Wade with LeBron James at center. He could see a bigger role Saturday if James and Jabari Walker are unavailable.
AJ Dybantsa made his first NBA appearance and started on Oct. 28. He scored 19 points with two rebounds and two assists in 27 minutes on a 27 percent usage rate.
Dybantsa shot well in his season debut but seemed frozen out at times by the other high-usage players on the team. His usage and minutes are the thing to watch in his second game Friday, Oct. 30.
He had 17 points, eight rebounds and a steal in 30 minutes as a starter Friday against Charlotte. He was back in the lineup after missing time.
Ajay Mitchell played only 23 minutes on Thursday. He scored 12 points with 5 steals but no rebounds or assists.
Ajay Mitchell is in line for a much larger role with Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace injured. As a starter last season he averaged about 29 minutes, 16 points, four rebounds and four assists.
He started Monday and had the highest usage on the team, scoring 30 points with five assists, a block and a three in 25 minutes. With Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace out, his role should stay large.
Ajay Mitchell is questionable with an ankle sprain.

Ajay Mitchell scored 29 points with four rebounds, three assists, two steals and a block in 28 minutes on Oct. 28 in a blowout loss. He took 20 shots on about 38 percent usage with several teammates out. He had been playing about 23 minutes a night when the team was healthy.
Al Horford returned on Oct. 26 and split the center minutes with Draymond Green.
Horford has more of a role because Golden State is short on big men and Steve Kerr has stopped playing some of his other options.
Alex Caruso has played 25 and 20 minutes off the bench in Oklahoma City's first two games.

He had 12 points, 7 rebounds, 6 assists, 2 steals and a block in 22 minutes on Sunday. He is averaging about 22 minutes a game, his most in several seasons, and could need more with Cason Wallace hurt.
Alex Caruso should see more opportunity after the Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace injuries, but Oklahoma City has historically limited his minutes and rested him often.
Alex Caruso has not played since Oct. 26, and his status for Saturday is unclear.
Alex Sarr had six points and nine rebounds in 24 minutes on Oct. 21. Anthony Davis plays the power forward spot but attacks the basket on offense, which pushes Sarr to the side.
Alex Sarr played only 23 minutes again on Saturday and had 10 points, 3 assists and 3 blocks.
Sarr is expected to play about 25 to 27 minutes a night if he stays out of foul trouble, and he is mostly a secondary option behind Trae Young, Anthony Davis and Kyshawn George.
He played 26 minutes Monday and has been held to about 24 minutes a game while sharing the frontcourt with Anthony Davis.
Alex Sarr had 12 points, six rebounds and two blocks in 26 minutes on Oct. 26, but his usage remained low at about 17%.
Alex Sarr scored 18 points with four rebounds, four steals and a block in 26 minutes on Oct. 28. His 26 minutes were an improvement over his earlier games.
Alex Sarr has played between 23 and 26 minutes in every game this season.
He played a season-high 29 minutes Friday against Charlotte but managed only three points and eight rebounds. He looks like the fifth offensive option in the starting five, behind Kyshawn George.

He played 20 minutes Sunday with 11 points, six rebounds, four assists, a steal, a block and a three. He has five blocks in his first three games and took many of the backup minutes at power forward without Kawhi Leonard.
Allen Graves has been productive in limited minutes and could see a few more with Kawhi Leonard out. He is not expected to go far past 20 minutes.
Sengun played 36 minutes on Friday and had 29 points, 7 rebounds and 7 assists.
He sat Wednesday with low back soreness, and Steven Adams (calf) and Marcus Smart (forearm) were also out. Fred VanVleet scored 24 as Houston moved to 5-0.
He missed Friday's 116-111 loss to Dallas, which ended Houston's 5-0 start.
Alperen Sengun is questionable tonight at Dallas with low back soreness after sitting Wednesday. Fred VanVleet scored 24 with Sengun out and is off the report for the first night of a back-to-back.
He missed Friday with low back soreness, and Clint Capela started at center with 11 rebounds and five assists in 30 minutes. Houston has not posted its injury report for Saturday yet.
Alpha Diallo took Cam Johnson's spot in the second half on Thursday after Johnson sprained his ankle. He played 22 minutes.
Alpha Diallo sat out Wednesday, Oct. 28 with a sprained wrist.
Amen Thompson blocked Victor Wembanyama at the rim to win Houston's game against San Antonio on Oct. 23. He had 20 points, 10 rebounds and two blocks.
Amen Thompson had 17 points and 11 rebounds at Atlanta on Oct. 24 for his third straight double-double. He played 39 minutes.

Amen Thompson has had a 23.7 percent usage rate without Alperen Sengun since the start of 2025, third on the team behind Kevin Durant and Reed Sheppard. He should pick up more rebounds and assists with Sengun out.
Amen Thompson's minutes rose back up to 33 on Oct. 28 after a low-minute game. He had 23 points, four rebounds and three assists.
He played 39 minutes at Dallas on Friday and had 15 points and six assists.
Andre Drummond is Karl-Anthony Towns' backup and is expected to play about 16 minutes a night.
Drummond played only 7 minutes on Friday with Towns out of foul trouble. His 24 minutes in the opener came because Towns had foul trouble.
He played only 7 minutes on Sunday, the same as third-string center James Wiseman.
Andre Drummond had 10 points and eight rebounds in 14 minutes off the bench on Tuesday.
Nembhard is starting next to Tyrese Haliburton and had 14 points with three assists on Sunday.
He returned Wednesday and had 18 points and 14 assists in 35 minutes, and he runs the offense with Haliburton out.
He had 22 points, nine assists and five three-pointers in 30 minutes Friday at Miami. His production is boosted while Tyrese Haliburton is out.
Andrew Wiggins played 27 minutes on Wednesday and finished with 11 points, 2 rebounds and 1 assist.
Wiggins played only 18 minutes on Saturday and was benched late as Pelle Larsson closed in his place.
Andrew Wiggins scored 18 points with four three-pointers and two blocks in 29 minutes Wednesday, getting more involved while Giannis Antetokounmpo was in foul trouble.
He had 12 points, two steals and a block in 30 minutes as a starter Friday against Indiana.
Anfernee Simons had 13 points and three threes in 25 minutes in his Oct. 20 debut. He played only 17 minutes on Oct. 22 when Philadelphia rode its starters in a comeback win over Cleveland.
Simons scored only five points in 27 minutes off the bench on Sunday, with two blocks.
Anfernee Simons scored 20 points with six threes in 27 minutes off the bench on Oct. 28. He is the main bench piece in a rotation that gives Philadelphia's starters heavy minutes.
Anfernee Simons should get more shots if Jaylen Brown, Joel Embiid and LeBron James sit. He scored 21 points with five 3-pointers in 31 minutes off the bench Friday.
Anthony Black is expected to start and could play around 32 minutes with Jalen Suggs and Paolo Banchero out.
Anthony Black moved into the starting lineup with Jalen Suggs out on Oct. 28. He had four fouls and played only 22 minutes, finishing with eight points, two rebounds, a steal and a block.
He started at Toronto on Friday and had 17 points and 10 assists in 31 minutes.
Anthony Davis had 18 points, five rebounds, three assists, one steal and two blocks in 34 minutes on Oct. 28.
He had 25 points, 13 rebounds, a steal and a block in 34 minutes Friday against Charlotte. He went 9-for-10 from the free-throw line.
Anthony Edwards scored 45 points with 10 rebounds and 9 threes in 33 minutes on Wednesday. He took 29 shots and carried about a 40% usage rate while playing more off the ball next to LaMelo Ball.
He scored 26 points in 28 minutes on Sunday while dealing with foul trouble.
Edwards has carried about a 35% usage rate to start the season.
He is recovering from arthroscopic knee surgery after a new exam following Monday's game showed he needed the procedure.

Ausar Thompson returned from an ankle injury Tuesday and started, which moved Daniss Jenkins to the bench. He fouled out in 25 minutes with 11 points, six rebounds, two steals and a block, with most of it coming in the fourth quarter.
Ausar Thompson started and fouled out in 25 minutes Tuesday.
Ausar Thompson had 7 points, 9 rebounds and 8 assists in 29 minutes on Oct. 28. He returned to an on-ball role after spending more time spotting up in the corner two games earlier.
Ausar Thompson had seven points, nine rebounds and eight assists in 29 minutes Wednesday.
He had 11 points, eight rebounds, six assists and two steals in 26 minutes Friday against Brooklyn. He looks to be over the ankle injury that bothered him for a couple of games.
Austin Reaves scored 26 points with seven assists and four rebounds in 39 minutes on Tuesday.
Austin Reaves had high usage on Oct. 28 but scored only 16 points with six rebounds on 6-of-16 shooting. He took only four free throws.
He had 21 points, four rebounds, five assists and eight turnovers in 37 minutes Friday at Golden State.
He scored 9 points in 23 minutes on Sunday.
Ayo Dosunmu played 26 minutes off the bench on Oct. 26 and did not play in overtime.
Ayo Dosunmu gets the second-biggest usage bump with Anthony Edwards off the floor, at about 24.5 percent. He is expected to step into the starting lineup with Edwards out.
Ayo Dosunmu moved into the starting lineup with Anthony Edwards out on Oct. 28. He had 17 points, three rebounds, four assists and four steals in 32 minutes on 16 percent usage.
He started and had 15 points, seven rebounds, two assists and a block in 30 minutes Friday against the Clippers.
Bam Adebayo took only 12 shots on Wednesday next to Giannis Antetokounmpo. He finished with 15 points, 7 rebounds, 4 assists and 3 steals in 31 minutes.
Bam Adebayo played only 23 minutes on Friday because he had 3 fouls in the first 8 minutes and did not play in the second quarter. He had 4 points, 6 rebounds and 3 assists with low usage.
His usage is down early, and he is being used more as a stretch big on the perimeter next to Giannis Antetokounmpo.

Bam Adebayo scored 24 points with nine rebounds and three steals in 33 minutes Wednesday. His usage had been down early in the season, and he got more involved when Giannis Antetokounmpo landed in foul trouble.
Bam Adebayo had 24 points, 9 rebounds and 3 steals on Oct. 28. Erik Spoelstra said before the game that the team needed to get him going.
He had 27 points, nine rebounds, three assists and three steals in 33 minutes Friday against Indiana.
Ben Sheppard is having surgery Wednesday to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee.
Ben Simmons is out for the season.
Bennedict Mathurin is barely playing off New Orleans' bench.
Mathurin scored 10 points in 19 minutes off the bench Thursday, Oct. 29.
Bennett Stirtz played 25 minutes on Oct. 26 but did little with them, scoring seven points. More time could open up with Alex Caruso out and Ajay Mitchell questionable.
Bennett Stirtz played 28 minutes on Oct. 28 and had eight points and three assists on very low usage.
Bilal Coulibaly scored three points in 29 minutes on Oct. 26 and is expected to lose his starting spot when AJ Dybantsa returns.
Bilal Coulibaly moved to the bench when AJ Dybantsa entered the starting lineup on Oct. 28. He still scored 17 points with two steals and two blocks in 27 minutes.
He scored one point in 22 minutes off the bench Friday against Charlotte. With AJ Dybantsa back, he projects as a 22-to-24-minute bench player.
The Clippers signed Blake Wesley to a 10-day contract using a hardship exception because of their injuries.
Bobby Portis had 13 points and 8 rebounds on Saturday with Giannis in foul trouble.
Bobby Portis has been one of Miami's best players despite playing only about 24 minutes a night off the bench.
Bobby Portis had 11 points, 9 rebounds and 4 assists with 3 stocks in 23 minutes off the bench on Oct. 28. He has settled into a role of about 21 to 27 minutes per game.
He had eight points, three rebounds and one assist in 17 minutes off the bench Friday against Indiana.

Bogdan Bogdanovic scored 16 points with two rebounds, four assists, two steals and four threes in 15 minutes on Oct. 28 against his former team. He got extra minutes and 22 percent usage with players out.

Bones Hyland was among the first three players off the bench on Oct. 28, along with Terrence Shannon Jr. and Joan Beringer. He scored 13 points in 16 minutes with a 28 percent usage rate and played some shifts alongside LaMelo Ball.
He had 19 points and eight assists off the bench in 20 minutes against the Clippers on Friday.
Braden Burries played only 16 minutes off the bench on Wednesday. He scored 12 points with 5 rebounds.
Braden Burries is playing only about 15 to 17 minutes a night.
Beal remains out.
Brandin Podziemski had only 12 percent usage on Oct. 28 as Yaxel Lendeborg and Stephen Curry took most of the shots. He had eight points, five rebounds and six assists with no steals or blocks.
He had 21 points, five rebounds, six assists, two steals and a block in 33 minutes Friday against the Lakers.
Brandon Ingram's return remains uncertain, though the Clippers are making it sound like he will play this season.
Brandon Miller had high early usage on Wednesday but went scoreless in the second half. He finished with 18 points, 3 rebounds and 1 assist in 36 minutes.
Brandon Miller has taken on huge shot volume and scored 34 points on Oct. 24 and 39 points on Oct. 26.
He scored 39 points with five threes, three steals and two blocks in 36 minutes Monday.
Brandon Miller had 31 points and 12 rebounds in 38 minutes on Oct. 28. He has taken between 26 and 29 shots in recent games and has played 36 or more minutes in each of his last four games.
He had 19 points, seven rebounds, two assists, a steal and a block in 37 minutes Friday at Washington, though he shot the ball poorly.
Williams started on Saturday with several Warriors out and had 20 points and five assists in 24 minutes. He had played only nine minutes in the prior game.
Brandon Williams moved out of the starting lineup on Oct. 26 with Golden State’s regulars back.
He has a career-high usage rate and is averaging 11 points, three rebounds, three assists and 1.5 steals in about 17 minutes a game.
He had nine points in 17 minutes off the bench Friday against the Lakers. He would likely move into a 26-minute role if Stephen Curry were injured.
Brayden Burries played only 8 minutes on Friday.
Brice Sensabaugh scored 16 points in 18 minutes off the bench on Oct. 28 with little else.
Brook Lopez played 27 minutes off the bench on Wednesday with Isaiah Jackson in foul trouble and outplayed him late. He had 17 points, 11 rebounds, a steal and a block.
Brook Lopez scored 22 points with 3 blocks off the bench on Friday but still played only 20 minutes behind starter Isaiah Jackson.
Lopez has been scoring very efficiently while playing 20 to 27 minutes, and he has come off the bench recently.
Brook Lopez had only two points in 22 bench minutes Wednesday.
He had 13 points, six rebounds and a block in 21 minutes off the bench Friday at Minnesota.
Bryce Hopkins started for Denver on Saturday, likely as a matchup decision, and played 19 minutes.
He started Monday and played 31 minutes with 13 points. His role could shrink as Denver's injured forwards return.
Bryce Hopkins moved out of the starting lineup on Oct. 28 after playing about 35 minutes in the previous game. He played 14 minutes off the bench and scored zero points.
Cade Cunningham had 19 points, nine rebounds and eight assists in 36 minutes on Tuesday and shot three of five from the line. Detroit plays the second night of a back-to-back Wednesday.
Cade Cunningham scored 30 points with four threes in 39 minutes on Oct. 28. He has been taking a lot more threes over his last few games with Jalen Duren out.
He had 20 points, five rebounds and four assists in 28 minutes Friday against Brooklyn. Detroit pulled its starters late in the win.

Caleb Wilson played 32 minutes in Wednesday's blowout loss to Toronto, the most on the Bulls, while carrying about 35% usage. He scored 16 points with 3 steals and a block but shot poorly and committed 9 turnovers.
Caleb Wilson had 30 points and 14 rebounds against Washington on Oct. 24 for his first career double-double, but he went 1 for 9 from 3-point range. He played 38 minutes.
Caleb Wilson played 32 minutes in a blowout loss on Oct. 26 while Chicago’s other starters sat late. He had 17 points, five rebounds, three assists, a steal and two blocks.
Caleb Wilson played 38 minutes on Oct. 28 and had 20 points. He has been getting big minutes, including in blowouts.
He had 23 points, five rebounds, four assists, two blocks and a steal in 31 minutes Friday in a blowout loss at Boston.
Cam Johnson was out on Oct. 28 and is expected to return fairly soon.

Cam Spencer had 8 points, 6 rebounds and 8 assists in 23 minutes off the bench on Oct. 29, and he is now clearly ahead of Scotty Pippen Jr. in the rotation. If Ty Jerome sits Saturday, either Spencer or Pippen would likely start.
Ty Jerome and Scotty Pippen Jr. are both questionable Saturday against Sacramento. Spencer has moved ahead of Pippen in the rotation and had eight assists in 23 minutes Thursday.
Cameron Boozer played 37 minutes on Friday and had 25 points, 13 rebounds, 6 assists and 2 steals, going 9-of-9 from the line.
Cameron Boozer had 13 points, seven rebounds and four assists on Oct. 26 but continues to struggle shooting from two-point range.
Cameron Boozer has played the most minutes on Memphis with a 25 percent usage rate and about 16 rebound chances per game. He has produced close to 1.2 fantasy points per minute.

Boozer posted a triple-double with 18 points, 12 rebounds and 12 assists in 28 minutes Thursday, Oct. 29, on about 20 percent usage in a blowout. He shot 60 percent after shooting about 28 percent before this game.
Cameron Carr missed the Lakers' opener on Oct. 21 with an oblique injury.
He returned from his ankle injury and started Friday against Phoenix, playing 34 minutes with 12 points, nine rebounds and a steal.
Cason Wallace started but played only 19 and 24 minutes in Oklahoma City's first two games. He had four steals and three threes on Oct. 22.
Cason Wallace has a torn labrum in his left shoulder and needs surgery. A timeline will come after surgery.
He took only six shots in 28 minutes as a starter on Wednesday. He had seven points, seven rebounds, two assists and a block.
He returned to the starting lineup on Sunday and had 15 points and 11 rebounds in 32 minutes.

Cedric Coward leads Memphis with 16.7 rebound chances per game and grabbed 11 rebounds with 16 points in 31 minutes on Oct. 26. Fouls have been a problem for him, and he has been shooting threes at an unsustainably high rate.
Coward had 17 points, seven rebounds, four assists and three steals in 27 minutes Thursday, Oct. 29, on 50 percent shooting. He has played about 30 minutes a night since a quiet season opener.
Cedric Coward has played in four of Memphis' five games and is averaging about 29 minutes. He has been playing power forward minutes when Cameron Boozer slides to center.
Chaney Johnson, who is on a two-way contract, played 29 minutes on Oct. 27 and scored 15 points.

Johnson, a two-way player, has been a regular part of the rotation at about 21 minutes a game, averaging seven points and four rebounds. He should get 15 to 20 minutes with Brooklyn's center group struggling.
Charles Bassey had 10 points, 7 rebounds and 2 blocks in 13 minutes on Saturday.
Charles Bassey played only two minutes on Oct. 28.
He took only 10 shots on Sunday and finished with 10 points and 4 rebounds in 31 minutes.
He has a small patellar tendon tear and received a biological treatment instead of surgery. Oklahoma City says he will miss 8 to 10 weeks.
He is out 8 to 10 weeks with a small patellar tendon tear, so Isaiah Hartenstein and Aday Mara take on the frontcourt minutes.
Christian Anderson would be the likely backup point guard if Dennis Schroder sits, but he has played only 9 to 16 minutes in each of his games.
Christian Braun had 15 points, four assists, three steals and a block in 36 minutes on Oct. 28.
He scored 31 points with seven three-pointers and three steals in 37 minutes Friday against Phoenix.
CJ McCollum played 30 minutes on Oct. 26 and had 20 points, four steals and four three-pointers.
CJ McCollum has played 30 minutes in back-to-back games after an uneven role in the first two games. Aaron Wiggins has still been taking a lot of minutes.
CJ McCollum started but played only 20 minutes on Oct. 28 and was not in the closing lineup. It was the second time this season he was benched late, and Kingston Flemings closed over him.
CJ McCollum started Wednesday but played only 20 minutes as Kingston Flemings took much of his playing time. He scored 13 points.
CJ McCollum started and played 31 minutes on Oct. 29, finishing with 5 points and 8 assists. He had played only 20 minutes on Oct. 28.
CJ McCollum's minutes have swung early in the season because of a blowout and a slow start in the opener. On Oct. 28 against Miami he played 20 minutes while Kingston Flemings took 28.
Clint Capela did not start on Oct. 28 even with Alperen Sengun and Steven Adams out. He had 10 points, eight rebounds, three steals and two blocks in 22 minutes off the bench.
He started at center with Alperen Sengun out Friday against Dallas and had five points, 11 rebounds, five assists, two steals and two blocks in 30 minutes.
He has missed every game this season with a calf injury, including Friday at Washington.
Collin Gillespie played 21 minutes off the bench on Oct. 21 and did not score. He is unlikely to be part of Phoenix's closing lineup when the team is healthy.
Gillespie played 28 minutes off the bench on Saturday and had 11 points, four rebounds and nine assists. He played more minutes than starter Jalen Green.
Collin Gillespie had nine points in 23 minutes off the bench on Oct. 26.

He had 16 points, 10 assists, three rebounds, four steals and a block in 33 minutes off the bench Friday at Denver. His minutes were boosted by Dillon Brooks' ejection after he had been shooting poorly to start the season.
Murray-Boyles had 3 fouls in the first 8 minutes on Friday and 5 fouls total in 18 minutes. He still had 3 steals.
He had 3 points, 7 rebounds and a block in 19 minutes on Sunday. He has not topped 20 minutes in any game this season.
Collin Murray-Boyles has come off the bench and has not played more than 20 minutes in any game. He picked up early fouls on Oct. 28 and played 15 minutes.

He played 23 minutes off the bench Friday at Orlando and had 15 points, five rebounds and one assist. He picked up three fouls quickly and was subbed off, and foul trouble has been an ongoing problem limiting his minutes.
Collin Sexton missed the Lakers’ opener and has been worked back into the rotation as a bench scorer.
Collin Sexton played 14 minutes off the bench on Tuesday and scored nine points.
Collin Sexton scored 21 points with four three-pointers in 21 bench minutes Wednesday with Luka Doncic out. He is still on a minutes cap.
He scored zero points in 16 minutes off the bench Friday at Golden State. The Lakers' bench scored only seven points in the game.

Cooper Flagg returned from his shoulder injury and had 29 points, 11 assists, six rebounds, five steals and three blocks at Miami on Oct. 26. He scored 12 points in the fourth quarter. He played 40 minutes.
Cooper Flagg played 33 minutes in a blowout win Wednesday and had 26 points and eight assists, while most other Dallas players stayed in the 20s for minutes.
He had 33 points, nine rebounds, six assists, two steals and a block in 39 minutes Friday at Houston, without making a three-pointer.
He played 33 minutes in Portland's last game on Oct. 23 and scored 19 points.
Damian Lillard averaged 21.7 points over his first three games. His free-throw percentage has been well below his career mark.

Portland's head coach said Damian Lillard, Jrue Holiday and Ja Morant will very rarely play 36 minutes and will mostly sit in the 28-to-32-minute range, with more possible when they are playing well. Lillard played 31 minutes and scored 21 points on Oct. 27.
Lillard had nine points, two rebounds and two assists in 30 minutes Thursday, Oct. 29. He made only one of nine 3-point attempts and struggled at the free-throw line for a second straight game.
Gafford had 12 points, nine rebounds, three steals and two blocks in 23 minutes on Saturday. He appeared to get hurt but returned to the game.
He started and fouled out in 26 minutes Monday with eight points, nine rebounds and two blocks. He is getting more run while Dereck Lively II is out.
Daniel Gafford started at center Wednesday and had seven points, 11 rebounds and two blocks in 27 minutes. He is getting starter's minutes until another Dallas center returns.
He started and played 29 minutes Friday at Houston, finishing with 18 points, seven rebounds and two blocks. His minutes have risen in four straight games.
He started in place of Ausar Thompson on Sunday and had 18 points, 8 rebounds, 6 assists, a block and 3 threes in 38 minutes. His role depends on whether Thompson and Isaiah Joe return.
Daniss Jenkins went back to the bench when Ausar Thompson returned on Oct. 27. He played 24 minutes with 11 points after starting and playing 38 minutes on Oct. 25.
Daniss Jenkins played 24 minutes off the bench Tuesday with Ausar Thompson back in the lineup.
He scored six points with five assists in 24 minutes off the bench Friday against Brooklyn, with some of those minutes coming in garbage time.
Darius Acuff Jr. scored 33 points in 37 minutes on Oct. 23. He is running a usage rate around 36 percent despite poor shooting.
He scored 22 points with 7 assists and a block in 36 minutes on Sunday on very heavy shot volume and poor efficiency. He has been taking more than 20 shots a night as a rookie.
Darius Acuff Jr. has been very inefficient but keeps getting heavy shot volume and strong minutes. He went 8-for-20 and scored 19 points in 33 minutes on Oct. 27.
Sacramento rode its starters heavily Thursday, Oct. 29, playing them 41, 41, 40, 39 and 37 minutes in a loss to New Orleans.
Darius Acuff Jr. scored a career-high 34 points with 14 assists and six rebounds in 41 minutes in Thursday's loss at New Orleans.
Sacramento has handed the offense to Darius Acuff Jr., but he has shot very poorly from the field in the early season.
Darius Garland had 26 points and 6 assists in 37 minutes on Friday with usage around 35 percent.
Darius Garland played only 26 minutes on Oct. 28 after playing 32 to 37 minutes in each of his first three games.
He had 24 points, five assists and a steal in 31 minutes Friday at Minnesota. He is playing through a back issue.
Darryn Peterson made the go-ahead free throws with 50.5 seconds left against New Orleans on Oct. 23. He played 30 minutes.
He scored 8 points with 3 steals and a block in 30 minutes on Sunday. His usage has been low so far.
He had 14 points, seven rebounds and four assists in 26 minutes Monday. He could see more usage with Utah's frontcourt injuries.
Darryn Peterson is still playing about 30 minutes a night despite shooting poorly.

Darryn Peterson had very high usage on Oct. 28 with Jaren Jackson Jr. and Lauri Markkanen out, but he was benched down the stretch and played only 26 minutes. He had 18 points, five rebounds, three assists and three threes on 31 percent shooting and made all seven free throws.
He took the second-most shots on Miami Monday and scored 21 points. He is averaging 18 points, seven assists and 34 minutes through four games, with his usage up sharply.

Davion Mitchell had 10 points and 10 assists in 34 minutes Wednesday. He is averaging about 34 minutes a game, up from 29 last season, and his shot volume has risen from about seven and a half to roughly 12 shots a game.
He had 15 points and 11 assists in 35 minutes as a starter Friday against Indiana.

Day’Ron Sharpe played only 16 minutes against Indiana on Oct. 25 because he was ejected and the game was a blowout. His assist rate and rebound rate are down with Julius Randle and Michael Porter Jr. taking most of the usage.
Day’Ron Sharpe has taken over as Brooklyn’s starting center from Nic Claxton.
Day’Ron Sharpe played only 17 minutes on Tuesday with four points and six rebounds. He had foul trouble, but Brooklyn also used Mo Wagner, Chaney Johnson and Noah Clowney over him late.
Day’Ron Sharpe is Brooklyn's starting center, but early foul trouble has limited him. Moritz Wagner and Chaney Johnson are taking some of the frontcourt minutes, and he played 17 minutes on Oct. 27.
Day’Ron Sharpe has started every game at center for Brooklyn. His minutes have dropped to 16 and 17 in his last two games.
He started and had three points, seven rebounds, a steal and two blocks in 24 minutes Friday at Detroit. He is the clear fifth option on offense and is losing minutes to Mo Wagner.
De'Aaron Fox was called for a Flagrant 1 foul for throwing Chet Holmgren to the court in the second quarter on Oct. 20.
De'Aaron Fox scored 19 points at Dallas on Oct. 24. He played 28 minutes.
De'Aaron Fox played only 26 minutes on Tuesday and had 11 points with six assists.
De’Aaron Fox had 14 points, three rebounds, four assists, three steals and a block in 39 minutes on Oct. 28 on 42 percent shooting.
